messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary cluster (us-west-canary) health degen. 5xx rate went from 0.4% -> 18% over 3m. Sources: canary-health, loadbalancer-proxy. Paging @sam_oncall and @olivia. https://metrics.redwood.internal/canary/graph?panel=502

olivia: on it, taking lead. I'm in the canary dashboard now.

sam_oncall: thanks — paging acknowledged, will join. any obvious deploy/tag?

olivia: recent rollout: model-serving:v3.2.7 rolled at 15:12 UTC, canary traffic 10%. Repro on staging looked fine but saw KV cache pressure warnings.

maria_ops: seeing elevated connection resets from proxy-nlb to inference pods, pods showing increased p99 latency. Might be kernel file-descriptor exhaustion on a subset.

kai_sre: I can run quick smoke and tail logs. hooking into cluster.

olivia: plan: 1) reduce traffic to canary to 0% (drain), 2) if errors persist on warm pods, manual rollback of canary to model-serving:v3.2.6, 3) run smoke tests and confirm error rate back to baseline. who can flip the flag?

maria_ops: I can flip traffic and drain. prepping commands.

olivia: tagging @emma_support for customer visibility — any Riot or top customers hitting failures?

emma_support: support queue shows a handful of errors from internal QA org. No P0 customer tickets yet. I'll escalate if something pops.

maria_ops: draining canary now — running:

```bash
# reduce canary weight to 0%
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --env us-west --service inference --canary 0
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deployment/model-serving-canary
```

maria_ops: canary weight → 0% (API returned 200). waiting for active connections to drop. :hourglass:

deploy-bot: NOTICE: Traffic weight change applied by maria_ops. previous_canary_weight=10 → new_canary_weight=0.

kai_sre: tailing logs on the three canary pods:

```
kubectl -n inference logs model-serving-canary-0 -f | grep -i error | tail -n 50
```

kai_sre: logs show repeated "KV cache eviction" warnings and downstream 502 from local runtime. looks like a memory regression in v3.2.7 when paired with our compile flags.

olivia: since draining didn't immediately remove errors from the warm pool, we should rollback canary to v3.2.6. manual rollback starting in 2 mins. maria, coordinate host-level drain and restart. kai, prepare smoke script, sam, you'll watch customer-facing metrics.

maria_ops: initiating manual rollback:

```bash
# rollback canary to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/model-serving-canary model-serving=image:model-serving:v3.2.6
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-serving-canary
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout initiated by maria_ops: deployment/model-serving-canary -> image: model-serving:v3.2.6. rollout_id=rb-1809990000-1

olivia: running smoke after each pod becomes Ready. smoke script:

```bash
# quick inference smoke
for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq '.choices[0].text' || exit 1; done
```

kai_sre: pod 0 -> Ready. smoke OK. pod 1 -> Ready. smoke OK. pod 2 -> Ready. smoke OK. running 100rps short test.

sam_oncall: monitoring error rate and user 502s on Top-10 accounts. dashboard: 5xx now at 1.2% and trending down. latency p95 back to baseline. :thumbsup:

emma_support: support channels: no new customer complaints since drain. QA org errors decreasing to background. I will message CS & status page if any regression.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: rollout rb-1809990000-1 succeeded. all 3 canary pods at image v3.2.6 and Ready.

olivia: verified end-to-end. canary error rate baseline ~0.5%. starting canary re-introduction only if needed. For now keep canary at 0% until we patch the v3.2.7 regen.

maria_ops: left a sticky note on cluster: check ulimits on canary hosts, kernel bump planned in followup.

kai_sre: creating a short repro playbook and an eval test to catch kv-cache mem-pressure. I'll open a ticket linking to ci/regression tests.

sam_oncall: documenting timeline and tagging postmortem. I'll hand off to owner @olivia for follow-up and root cause assignment.

olivia: thanks team. summary for incident channel: rollback of model-serving:v3.2.7 on canary completed, customer impact limited to internal QA, immediate mitigation successful. prepping a short postmortem draft.

emma_support: I'll update this thread if any support escalations appear. otherwise :white_check_mark:

sam_oncall: closing pager for now. follow-ups: kernel ulimit fix, CI regression for kv-cache, full postmortem in 24h.

olivia: assigning action items in GH: #4321 (rollback postmortem), #4322 (kv-cache test), #4323 (kernel ulimit ops change).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (severity: S2) — root cause suspected memory regression in v3.2.7 interaction with kv-cache. oncall: sam_oncall. owners: olivia, kai_sre, maria_ops.

sam_oncall: nice work all. :clap:
